words.definition: sounds made by singing or instruments that people enjoy
words.example: I love listening to music.

words.definition: a piece of music with words that you sing
words.example: This is my favorite song.

words.definition: to make music with your voice
words.example: She sings very well.

words.definition: to move your body to music
words.example: We dance at every party.

words.definition: a thing you use to make music, like a guitar
words.example: The piano is a big instrument.

words.definition: a musical instrument with strings that you play with your fingers
words.example: My brother plays the guitar.

words.definition: a big musical instrument with black and white keys
words.example: She plays the piano every day.

words.definition: a musical instrument that you hit with your hands or sticks
words.example: He plays the drum in a band.

words.definition: things like paintings and drawings that people make and enjoy
words.example: I like art class at school.

words.definition: to make a picture using colors
words.example: I paint pictures of flowers.

words.definition: a picture made with paint
words.example: This painting shows the sea.

words.definition: to make a picture using a pencil or pen
words.example: My sister can draw very well.

words.definition: a picture made with a pencil or pen
words.example: He showed me his new drawing.

words.definition: a drawing, painting, or photo
words.example: There is a picture on the wall.

words.definition: the quality that makes things look red, blue, green, and so on
words.example: My favorite color is blue.

words.definition: a person who makes art or music
words.example: She is a famous artist.

words.definition: a show where musicians play music for people
words.example: We went to a concert last night.

words.definition: a small group of musicians who play together
words.example: My friend is in a rock band.

words.definition: to pay attention to a sound
words.example: I listen to music on the bus.

words.definition: to sing, dance, or play music in front of people
words.example: The band performs every Friday.

text: I really love music and art. Every day, I listen to music on my phone, and I know many songs. My sister can sing very well, but I like to play the guitar. My brother plays the piano, and my cousin plays the drum. Sometimes we make our own small band at home! Last month, we went to a concert and watched our favorite singer perform on stage. It was amazing. At school, I also like art class. We paint pictures with many colors, and I draw animals and flowers. My teacher says my drawing is very good. My friend wants to be an artist when she grows up. She made a beautiful painting of the mountains, and now it is in our classroom. Art and music make me happy. When I feel sad, I dance to my favorite song or draw a picture. Learning to play an instrument is not easy, but I practice every day. I hope one day I can perform in a big concert with my own band.
